title: MEASURE TWICE, CUT ONCE: QUANTIFYING BIAS AND FAIRNESS IN DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any measurements related to faith or religion. It proposes and evaluates two metrics, Combined Error Variance (CEV) and Symmetric Distance Error (SDE), to quantify class-wise bias and fairness in multi-class classification models, using datasets with non-religious protected attributes like gender and physical appearance.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. The analysis is focused on developing general-purpose fairness and bias metrics for deep neural networks in multi-class classification tasks, with experiments conducted on datasets like CIFAR100, ImageNet, Titanic, and CelebA using non-religious attributes.
